jordan (customer): Hey, console shows our org credit balance as $1,500 but API/service key calls are still billed. service key: svc-prod-42. Can you check?

maya (support): Sorry about that — can you share the org id and a quick repro curl you ran?

jordan (customer): org id: org-9876. Repro I ran: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer svc-prod-42\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/billing/credits` -> response: `{\"credit_balance\":0,\"currency\":\"USD\"}`

maya (support): Thanks. Can you confirm in the Console which scope shows the $1,500? org-level or project-level? screenshot would help if possible.

jordan (customer): It's showing on the org banner and in org billing overview. Project list still shows 0 credits for each project. Screenshot: (uploads)

maya (support): Understood. This looks like an allocation/sync mismatch between org credits and service-key/project-level allocation. Looping in billing and infra. @chris can you take a look?

chris (billing): Got it. I'll check the ledger and allocation runs. Two quick checks: (1) confirm promo grant event exists for org-9876, (2) check last successful \"credit-allocator\" job run.

infra-bot: Scheduled job `credit-allocator` last run: 2026-02-14T03:12:08Z, status: partial_success (1 failed allocation)

eli (engineer): Partial success could be a transient mapping error (project ID mapping missing at allocation time). Do you have the promo code id or grant id?

jordan (customer): promo code redeemed: REDWOOD-APR24, grant id: grant-5582.

chris (billing): I see grant-5582 in the ledger. Allocation attempt failed for project mapping step due to missing project mapping for one of the org projects at the time of allocation. I'm going to trigger a manual resync for org-9876 and backfill allocations.

chris (billing): Running manual resync: `POST /internal/ops/credit-sync?org=org-9876` -> job id: job-3347. Will post updates.

maya (support): FYI Jordan — I tagged this urgent and created support ticket SUP-9241 so we can track externally.

infra-bot: job-3347 started by chris at 2026-02-14T10:05:12Z

chris (billing): job-3347 finished: allocations applied to 3 projects, service keys updated. Please verify with the same curl.

jordan (customer): re-running same curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer svc-prod-42\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/billing/credits` -> now returns `{\"credit_balance\":1500,\"currency\":\"USD\"}`. Console also matches.

maya (support): Great — thanks for confirming. Root cause: promo grant allocation job ran while one project mapping was missing (race during org import), allocation partially failed and left org-level display updated but not service-key/project allocations.

eli (engineer): We've deployed a fix to the allocator to retry mapping retrieval and added a short mutex so allocations wait for project sync. We'll also run a backfill for the small number of affected orgs.

chris (billing): Backfill scheduled and completed for org-9876. No billing impact beyond delayed allocation; credits were not double-applied.

maya (support): Closing SUP-9241 as resolved; leaving thread open for 24h in case Jordan sees any flakiness. Thanks for the quick repro and confirm, Jordan :thumbsup:

jordan (customer): Thank you all — everything looks normal again. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

maya (support): Notes for internal follow-up: action items recorded in SUP-9241: (1) allocator retry & mutex deployed, (2) backfill script run, (3) add monitoring alert for partial_success in credit-allocator jobs.

infra-bot: SUP-9241 status updated to RESOLVED at 2026-02-14T11:02:03Z
